title: Binary Identity Machine
statement: There is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with no work tapes and a single state. On each input bit it moves the input head one position to the right, outputs that bit, and remains in its state; when it scans a blank, it stays in place, outputs nothing, and halts.
